column1: # Forever loot of Blackfathom Deeps (map 48): the boss drop and quest reward rows (spec jvbastel/WOWAI#240, ticket
# #246). The items are in loot_blackfathom_deeps_items.tsv. The layout of the loot files is in forever/REFRESH.md,
# "Dungeon loot". forever/generator writes a drop row into forever_creature_loot_template: a copy of every stock row of
# the boss's creature loot entry plus the new row, outside the stock equal-chance group, with patch_min 0. A reward
# row becomes a forever_quest_template copy of the stock quest with the Forever reward choices.
# Sources, read 2026-10-31: Wowhead's Forever tooltip data ("Dropped by" and "Drop Chance" of each item,
# https://nether.wowhead.com/tooltip/item/<id>?dataEnv=16&locale=0) and the Forever quest pages
# (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=<id>, read with a web-fetch tool, summaries in notes/forever/wowhead-cache/quest).
# A drop is confirmed when the tooltip's "Dropped by" names the boss; its chance is the tooltip's "Drop Chance".
# Quests with an objective in Blackfathom Deeps that show the stock rewards on Wowhead Forever, no row: 971, 1198,
# 1654, 6563, 6565, 6921 (their stock reward items with Forever stats are in the items file). No Forever source lifts
# a class lock of a BFD quest reward. Baron Aquanis (12876) has no new drop.
# Quest 1199 Twilight Falls: stock gives 6998 and 7000 both as fixed rewards (RewItemId). The Forever page (read again
# 2026-10-31) lists 6998, 7000 and 270025 under "You will be able to choose one of these rewards" and 270025 once more
# under "You will also receive". The page contradicts itself, and the generator has no row kind that turns fixed
# rewards into choices: the row is unconfirmed (left out and listed).
# Stock boss drops keep their stock chance (spec #240): they have no drop row.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   kind        drop: a new item on a boss; reward: a new reward choice of a quest (replaces "-") or a swapped one;
#               unlock: the quest reward item loses its class lock (the item needs a row in the items file)
#   item        the item ID (a row of a loot items file, or a stock item)
#   name        the item name
#   target      drop: the boss (creature entry); reward, unlock: the quest ID
#   targetName  the stock name of the boss or the title of the quest (the generator compares it)
#   loot        drop: "creature" (the boss's creature loot entry) or "reference <ID>" (a reference loot entry that only
#               this boss uses); else "-"
#   chance      drop: the drop chance in percent; else "-"
#   replaces    reward: the stock reward choice it replaces, or "-" to add it in the first empty choice slot; else "-"
#   count       reward: the number of items; else "-"
#   status      confirmed, unconfirmed or unreadable (the generator leaves the row out and lists it); a drop can
#               also be left-out: confirmed, but kept out on purpose (a Forever camp blueprint), listed with its boss,
#               chance and `notes` as the reason
#   source      a Wowhead URL, or "client <build>"
#   date        the day the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD
#   notes
